summary: SuperCom Ltd filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 732,683 ordinary shares at $10.25 per share, raising ~$7.5M gross proceeds. The offering is priced at a ~15.6% discount to the July 10, 2026 closing price of $12.15. Maxim Group LLC serves as placement agent, receiving a 6.0% fee. This is an ordinary seasoned equity offering under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing lacks any transformative event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring, and proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
